title: Procedure File: 2026/0265(COD) | Legislative Observatory | European Parliament

triage.reason: The procedure file records the 11 November 2026 committee referral in Parliament for the Public Procurement Act, a new legislative step within the last 60 days for an instrument that amends the PPWR and Waste Framework Directive.

draft.summary: On 11 November 2026 the European Parliament announced the committee referral of procedure 2026/0265(COD), a proposal for a Public Procurement Act, at first reading. The procedure file records the stage reached as awaiting committee decision, with the committee dossier listed as IMCO/10/06606.
draft.source_quote: 11/11/2026 | Committee referral announced in Parliament, 1st reading

key_dates.text: Committee referral announced in Parliament, 1st reading

draft.interpretation: Parliamentary work on the file now moves into committee, where the procurement rules touching recycled and refurbished content can still be amended. Recyclers, converters and brand owners affected by green procurement criteria may find committee-stage amendments more decisive than later plenary votes.
